techTree.description: Raise a city on a 3:1 port so every resource trades 2:1 there (2 wood, 1 brick, 1 ore).
techTree.name: Harbor charters

techTree.description: Your discard limit is 2 higher.
techTree.name: Stockpiling

techTree.description: When you play a knight, the steal takes 1 extra card.
techTree.name: Plunder

techTree.description: Once: turn a land tile next to your settlement or city into a basic resource tile of your choice.
techTree.name: Ground work

techTree.description: Roads past the road cap (2x price) cost 1 less brick or wood.
techTree.name: Road levy

techTree.description: Unlocks Rickety Bridges (1 wood, 1 health, collapses on a 7; upgradeable to a full bridge) and raises your bridge cap by +4 before bridges cost 2x.
techTree.name: Rickety bridges

techTree.description: Unlocks Fishing Nets on coastal corners (catch wild fish tokens on dice rolls) and lets your Settlements on 3:1 ports be raised to 2:1.
techTree.name: Fishing nets

techTree.description: +25% shipwreck salvage loot, higher dev-card chance on sea wrecks, and unlocks Demolish Bridge (remove a bridge for half its cards back).
techTree.name: Salvage crew

techTree.description: Fishing Nets cost 1 less wood (1 wood + 1 sheep), base catch chance rises to 1 in 4 (1 in 2 when boosted), and boosted catches have a 1 in 3 chance to save the fish boost.
techTree.name: Net works

techTree.description: Driving off a pirate requires 2 fewer played knights (minimum 1) and grants +50% pirate loot.
techTree.name: Pirate hunter

techTree.description: Unlocks Harbors (upgrade a port city to 1:1 trade for up to 4 trades per turn, works while flooded) and Feed the Sea (1 wheat refills a fishing ground).
techTree.name: Harbor master

techTree.description: Longest Road is worth 16 VP instead of 2 (+14 VP) while you hold Longest Road and your road includes at least 1 bridge or rickety bridge.
techTree.name: Grand causeway

techTree.description: +1 Harbor limit (2 Harbors total) and immediately grants ceil(V / 2) random resource cards from the bank on unlock.
techTree.name: Harbor empire
